name: noolstack
description: NoolStack: the Vue app is in web/. This file lets hosts that build from the repo root (such as Catalyst Slate) build it. Catalyst's account pages ask for their stylesheets under /app/css/ (where the site lives on Catalyst), so the Slate build keeps a copy there too.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build -- --outDir ../dist && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('web/public/css','dist/app/css',{recursive:true})"
scripts.build:catalyst: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
